quotations.old_english: Seó láf [MS. lafe] wið ðone here fryþ nam
quotations.english: the remainder made peace with the army

quotations.old_english: Ðæt he ne beó nánes fryþes weorðe
quotations.english: that he be not worthy of any peace

source_text: fryþ, es; n. m? Peace: pax :-- Seó láf [MS. lafe] wið ðone here fryþ nam the remainder made peace with the army, Chr. 867; Erl. 73, 16: 1036; Th. 294, 9, col. 2. Ðæt he ne beó nánes fryþes weorðe that he be not worthy of any peace, L. Eth. iii. 15; Th. i. 298, 12. v. friþ.
